description.summary: The caster emulates the firestorm that the Red Dragon unleashes upon its foes
description.value: The caster emulates the firestorm that the Red Dragon unleashes upon its foes. Every target within the radius takes 15d8 fire damage, with a Reflex save for half, and must make an additional Reflex save. A target who fails both saves suffers serious burns, taking 1d12 fire damage each round, with two Reflex saves each round; making one save reduces this to normal Burning , while making both saves ends the effect entirely. A target who only fails one initial save is inflicted with the normal Burning status. Learned From Red Dragon , Kaiser Dragon , Tiger , and Omega Weapon
